items.text: Small factories, packaging units and warehouses want a specific task automated.
Compare it with mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and embedded systems.

blocks.heading: International Federation of Robotics, in Its

items.text: The International Federation of Robotics, in its World Robotics 2025 report as quoted by a university guide, ranks India as the tenth-largest market for robots in operation, with about 52,000 units.
The same guide lists the branches that lead to robotics work: mechatronics, automation and robotics, mechanical, electrical and electronics and communication engineering.
That guide also shows salary tables from a salary website, but it is a university marketing page and says the figures mainly reflect large firms.

blocks.heading: Beat a General Robotics Path
rows: Embedded or software engineering
More openings across industries, and robotics skills transfer in later.
Needs steady coding and electronics practice.
